findings.desc: quality-fail-closed: packages/main/src/handlers/review-inventory.ts:400 captures candidateArtifactInvalid but discards it; a truthy non-array persisted candidates value present before the first review_inventory_begin still signs and returns State: OPEN with no candidate digest. Only a later status/evidence command invalidates it, so the initial inventory gate violates the documented deterministic INVALID_CANDIDATE_ARTIFACT fail-closed behavior. Reject or immediately persist/render INVALIDATED at begin, and add a pre-begin malformed-artifact handler fixture.

CHK-001:content-and-selection-drift / CHK-001:order-only-scope lacks a selected-path mutation assertion. packages/main/src/tasks/review-inventory-handler-smoke.ts:809-818 mutates only candidates[0].contentHash; no valid artifact changes a selected candidate path and candidateSpecSet/basis then proves the real review_inventory_status handler emits OPEN_REVIEW_INVENTORY_CANDIDATE_ROUTING_MUTATION. The stated user outcome requires invalidation when either selected path or contentHash changes, so a regression that drops path from the canonical barrier remains undetected.
